mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_run (run_id, agent_type, product_id, seller_id, submitted_product_version, rule_version, model_name, status, attempt, input_snapshot) VALUES (#{runId}, #{agentType}, #{productId}, #{sellerId}, #{submittedProductVersion}, #{ruleVersion}, #{modelName}, #{status}, #{attempt}, #{inputSnapshot})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_agent_run WHERE run_id = #{runId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ai_agent_run WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent_run SET status='RUNNING', attempt=attempt+1, started_at=COALESCE(started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND status='PENDING'

UPDATE ai_agent_run SET status='SUCCEEDED', decision=#{decision}, risk_level=#{riskLevel}, confidence=#{confidence}, result_json=#{resultJson}, finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE ai_agent_run SET status=#{status}, error_code=#{errorCode}, error_message=#{errorMessage}, finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')
UPDATE ai_agent_run SET status='STALE', error_code=#{errorCode}, finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND status IN ('RUNNING','SUCCEEDED')
